query:
INSERT INTO memory.operator_turns (
            session_id, project_id,
            start_request_id,
            end_request_id,
            user_prompt,
            opened_by
         )
         SELECT $1, $2, $3, $3, $4, $5
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM memory.operator_turns
             WHERE session_id = $1 AND closed_at IS NULL
         )
         RETURNING id
